caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, jug-shaped ceramic vessel positioned upright on a plain, light-colored background. The vessel is tan or light brown in color and has a rounded body that tapers toward a narrower neck and a small, raised rim at the top. Attached to the upper right side of the neck is a single curved handle. The front surface of the vessel features a blue floral design painted in loose brushstrokes, depicting a central flower, a secondary bud, and several curling leaves and stems. Just below the vessel's neck, a small circular mark, possibly a maker’s stamp, is faintly visible. The lighting creates subtle shadows and highlights across the vessel, emphasizing its curved shape and matte texture. There are no other objects in the composition.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
